question: In terms of their magnetic properties, the elements named nickel and cobalt are classified as:
solution:
The correct answer is__** ferromagnetic.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Ferromagnetic materials** show parallel order of moments resulting in large net magnetization even in the **absence of a magnetic field.**
